profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer specialized in cloud automation. Skilled in Docker, Python, Terraform, CI/CD, and Linux systems.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Advocate a culture of automation to improve operational efficiency across cloud and datacenter infrastructure, internal processes, and software development workflows. 

• Collaborate with architects, systems engineers, managers and software developers to design and implement a CI/CD pipeline for a multi-product API gateway infrastructure.
• Write a tool to automate source code escrow deposits for use by multiple products.
• Research and develop scalable patterns for CI/CD infrastructure and implementations with Jenkins and Kubernetes.
• Develop Helm charts for products and product integrations.
• Design and implement on-premise infrastructure automation for ephemeral Kubernetes clusters using Rancher and Terraform.
• Advocate and utilize serverless technologies on various cloud platforms, including AWS and Azure when appropriate.
• Build and configure analytics tools to pinpoint code-related issues and operational bottlenecks to assist the business in making data driven decisions.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Part-time position to assist transitioning over 70 USTRANSCOM applications into a DevOps workflow as they are migrated to AWS GovCloud. Work involved developing a web application serving as the default home page for virtual desktops in the cloud development network. This application was intended to provide insight and metrics on deployment frequency, application health, user role information, and personalized links to project documentation and project-specific services.
• Architected frontend, backend and infrastructure as modular components.
• Developed backend API server using Python and Flask.
• Implemented a login feature with LDAP integration.
• Advanced the configuration management (Chef) scripts and pipeline scripts for the web application.
• Added feature to capture click-based metrics on the web application using DynamoDB.
• Assisted in researching CAC authentication through Nginx.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Introduction to DevOps culture and methodologies, government contracting, and AWS GovCloud.
• 	Refine the build pipeline service for USTRANSCOM application development. 
• 	Develop a single-page web application using Angular 5 to help navigate the USTRANSCOM development network.
• 	Assist in building and designing a cloud-based virtual development environment compliant with DISA STIG.

positions.title: Information Security Operations Assistant
positions.description:
Member of an integrated information security/legal compliance team comprised of student and full-time employees. 
• 	Orchestrate vulnerability scans for over 22,000 devices.
• 	Automate network security scanning (Nessus) operations and routine scanner system maintenance.
• 	Develop tools to automate various processes, such as malicious email reporting, network configuration checks, and network assignment lookups.
• 	Conduct monthly meetings with critical infrastructure teams.
• 	Participate in security investigations.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Part-time position to assist professor in creating, refining and teaching class materials.
• 	Facilitated students in learning intermediate level Java programming.
• 	Taught a workshop on source code management (gitlab) and new declarative programming features in Java 1.8.
